obligations.correction: Full two-coordinate modular Fibonacci matrix fold is bijective; bounded rung projection is not. This is an algebraic permutation, not an established cryptographic PRP.
User proposal has the opposite sign; n=1 gives +5.
Prime index injectivity follows from strictly ordered distinct primes; it is not a hash or consensus security theorem.
Conjugate magnitude is 1/phi<1; scaling is not generally a machine bit shift.
Bound follows from explicit clamp, not an assumed bounded log ratio. It controls coordinate budget, not proven consensus difficulty.
Uniform full input plus bijection preserves uniformity; projection to 2^b rungs has 2^(256-b) preimages each. Random headers do not supply a proved uniform digest theorem.
Deterministic valid computation and monotone rung value do not establish Sybil economics, fork choice or Bitcoin-equivalent reorg resistance.
Pipeline depth is distinct from initiation interval. Use cores*clock/II*occupancy*admissibility with explicit assumptions; no clock/EU/share equivalence is assumed.
Landauer bound uses erased bits, not arithmetic-operation counts. Actual erasures, physically reversible implementation and measured energy are unavailable.
